scope: Olympus TTL-O A4 candidate PIC18 keyboard acquisition, event state machine and normal-mode handlers

source.confidence: Instructions below are internally consistent static candidate evidence, not hardware validation.

limitations.zh: 物理键标签由处理语义推断，未在 Olympus 实物上按键验证。
limitations.en: Physical key labels are inferred from handler semantics and have not been verified on Olympus hardware.

limitations.zh: 250/650 是计数阈值，尚未确认真实时间单位；不得直接标成毫秒。
limitations.en: 250/650 are counter thresholds; the real time unit is unconfirmed and must not be labeled milliseconds.

limitations.zh: 候选解码与首字未知仍限制结论；本文件不是补丁、刷写许可或整机验证。
limitations.en: Candidate decoding and the unknown initial word limit the conclusions; this is not a patch, flashing authorization or full-device validation.

limitations.zh: 尚未闭合 flags bit5/bit6 的全部配置来源、非普通UI状态的完整行为以及模拟多键电压别名。
limitations.en: All writers of flags bits 5/6, complete non-normal UI behavior and analog multi-key voltage aliasing remain unresolved.

entry_flow.acquisition_gate: 0x5036..0x5044 calls 0x732C with pointer 0x00AF; returns if result zero
entry_flow.scanner: 0x5036..0x51EA updates all 12 slots, then resets/rearms scan timer through 0x8846 -> 0xA174 -> 0x883C
entry_flow.consumer: 0x9DF4..0x9E18 processes ONE slot per call: slot=0x100+4*RAM[0x080], CALL 0x596E, increment index and wrap at 12

slots.hold: 0x6E32..0x6E50 increments RAM[0x086]; after >5 enters UI state RAM[0x082]=1

slots.label_confidence: medium semantic; field values not externally labeled
slots.press: 0x5C38..0x5C56 -> 0x8F00 only when struct[0]!=0 and RAM[0x081]==0; otherwise 0xA4F4

slots.label_confidence: high semantic inference; no physical test
high semantic inference; no physical test
slots.press: 0x5CC4..0x5CEA -> indirect function pointer RAM[0x066..0x068], then 0x5CEC..0x5D38 rearm timer

slots.label_confidence: low/medium semantic; explicit flash-output proof not completed
medium semantic; low-level power proof not completed

sample_filter.evidence: 0x9302..0x930C tests input==1; 0x931A..0x9322 preserves old bit7; 0x9326 stores only slot[0]

layout.+0: 7-bit sample history plus confirmed-down latch bit7
layout.+2: timestamp low byte, not plain elapsed
layout.+3: timestamp high byte including sentinel bit15

flags.bit7: repeat/rearm marker set by 0x9934; not read inside 0x596E

press.action: clear flag3; if flag0 clear, save timestamp, set flag0, CALL 0x80F4; finally set history bit7

hold.threshold250: elapsed>=0x00FA, flag5 clear, flag1 clear -> set flag1 -> 0xABC2 (RETURN-only stub)
hold.threshold650: elapsed>=0x028A, flag5/flag6/flag2 clear -> set flag2 -> tail GOTO 0x9ED6

release.action: if flag3/flag4 clear, set flag3 and CALL 0x83B0; regardless of callback, flags=0x08, timestamp=0, history=0

dispatch.press: 0x80F4 -> 0xA838 eligibility guard; rejected -> 0xA84A; accepted normal UI state RAM[0x082]==0 -> 0x8110 -> tail GOTO 0x5C12
dispatch.release: 0x83B0 -> UI state RAM[0x082]==0 -> 0x83B2 -> CALL 0x87BA; at 0x83FC clears RAM[0x086], RETURN
dispatch.other_ui_states: 0x80F4/0x83B0 dispatch to 0x9C04/0xA8FE and 0xA5C4/0xA5DC/0xA5F4. Not fully mapped.

event_state_machine.consume: No separate pop/read-and-clear API confirmed. Synchronous callbacks plus latched flags; full clear occurs at release.

repeat.action: flags &= 0xBB (clear bits2/6); set bit7; rewrite timestamp. Called by every 650 handler, allowing another 650-count period while held; flag1 stays set.

timestamp.save: 0xA4DA -> 0xAB2E reads RAM[0x075:0x076]; 0x8E00 -> 0xAA52 normalizes to 15 bits, 0 becomes 1; result BB:BC stored by 0x5AB8
timestamp.overflow_side_effect: At delta>=0x5DC1 (24001), 0x6708..0x672A can replace saved value with bit15-marked coarse representation; current call still returns delta and subsequent call returns 0xFFFF.

mode_and_callbacks.config_pointer_initialization: 0x57A2 MOVLW 0x99; 0x57A4 MOVWF 0xF3,BANKED; 0x57A6 MOVLW 1; 0x57A8 MOVWF 0xF4,BANKED; 0x57AA CALL 0x5520. At 0x5520/0x5524, MOVFF 0x0F3->0x07E and 0x0F4->0x07F. Thus pointer=0x0199. Only these two direct writes to 0x07E/0x07F were found in the listing.
mode_and_callbacks.config_read_helper: 0x5666 reads config[0]; 0x849C adds config pointer to FSR2

mode_toggle.evidence: 0x6A74..0x6A8C writes config[0] = (old==1 ? 0 : 1) when RAM[0x081]==0. RAM[0x081]!=0 path writes 1.
mode_toggle.followup: 0x6A8E clears relative aggregate RAM[0x061]; 0x6AA0 calls pointer RAM[0x06C..0x06E] to select power callback; updates timers/display path.
mode_toggle.semantic_inference: config[0]==0 strongly matches TTL group compensation; config[0]==1 strongly matches MAN relative adjustment. Physical display-label proof is separate.
mode_toggle.caveat: Normal key dispatcher with RAM[0x081]!=0 routes to 0xA4F4, not directly to 0x6A62.

other_fields.+2: 0x8F00 changes 2<->3 only when config[0]==1; likely SYNC, not the TTL/MAN field
other_fields.+4,+5,+6: signed group compensation values, limited to -20..20

selection.behavior: W=1/2/3; if equal to current selection selects 7, otherwise selects W; tail-calls 0x609A.
selection.setup: 0x609A stores selection and installs pointers. 0x6148 calls RAM[0x06C..0x06E] then tail GOTO 0x84A6.

mode_and_callbacks.model_path: Per-group callbacks modify RAM[0x03F].bit0/1/2 using corresponding enable bit RAM[0x02C]; 0x8722 combines 3F & 2C into display/state flags; tail 0x8974 builds command with MOVLW 0x8D at 0x8996.
mode_and_callbacks.head_path: Per-group callbacks toggle RAM[0x02C].bit0/1/2; all callback toggles 0<->7; updates 0x8722 and tail 0x9EB2 -> 0x89BC. No direct opcode 0x8C claim is made.

plus_minus.argument: W signed byte delta; saved in RAM[0x0EA]
plus_minus.mode0: 0x8A4C/0x814E/0x8BAA add signed delta to config+4/+5/+6 only if group enabled in RAM[0x02C]. Clamp via 0x90EA using upper=0x14/lower=0xEC (-20..20); emit through 0x876E.
plus_minus.mode1: 0x90AE/0x9072/0x9036 add signed delta to RAM[0x036]/[0x037]/[0x038], gated by RAM[0x02C] group enable; 0x6930 does all three. Clamp via 0x69BC -> 0x90EA using upper=0x63/lower=0x9D (-99..99).
plus_minus.return_flow: mode1 after indirect callback: 0x8716..0x871A adds delta to RAM[0x061] then RETURN; mode0 after callback: if selection==7 RETURN at 0x86F4, else tail GOTO 0x7B14
plus_minus.limits: Signed add occurs before clamp. Unit 0.1 EV is a semantic inference, not directly proved by this keyboard trace.

validation.method: Read-only static listing analysis, independent state-machine/timestamp review, and byte preimages extracted from supplied decoded candidate.
validation.checks: PASS: UTF-8 JSON parse, source SHA-256, 19 preimage windows byte-for-byte match, 12 unique slots and all 12 CALL 0x92FC sites.
validation.encoding_note: Files are UTF-8; Windows PowerShell Get-Content requires -Encoding UTF8 to avoid interpreting Chinese text with the system ANSI code page.
